one_liner: Research and write policy memos and briefings on financial stability and financial regulation for Treasury's Financial Stability Oversight Council staff in DC.
fit_summary: Every grade requires specialized experience in financial markets, financial institutions or U.S. financial regulatory policy. Daniel's resume shows none, so even GS-11 is unlikely.
eligibility: Open to the public (U.S. citizens/nationals), so Daniel needs no federal status; a clearance is not required, but a background investigation and confidential financial disclosure are.
GS-11 requires one year of GS-9-level experience researching and analyzing financial markets or financial institutions AND writing policy analysis on them.
GS-12 and GS-13 require one year of next-lower-grade experience with U.S. financial regulatory policy and engagement with financial regulatory agencies.
Education can substitute only with a Ph.D., 3 years of related doctoral-level graduate study, or a related LL.M.; a combination of experience and education is assessed in the questionnaire.
Must pass an online competency assessment and reach the cut-off score of 89 to be referred.
strategy: Skip this one; his policy research is in public health, not finance.
Target policy analyst roles that fit his background better, such as those at FEMA, DHS, Virginia VDEM, Northern Virginia local emergency management or legislative offices.
resume_bullets: Studied economic globalization and global trade relations for an M.A. in Global Affairs (George Mason, 2016).
Tracked state implementation of the Rural Health Transformation Program from November 2025, identifying which states were executing well and which were struggling.
interview_questions: Describe a time you turned complex research into a short memo for a senior decision-maker. What did you leave out and why?
What do you see as current risks to U.S. financial stability, and what is FSOC's role in addressing them?
How would you assess the effect of a proposed financial regulation on the financial system?
Tell us about coordinating with outside agencies or stakeholders who had competing priorities.
watch_outs: Specialized experience is heavily finance-specific, so emergency-management consulting alone will likely rate not qualified.
The cut-off score of 89, the online assessment, and veterans' preference ordering make referral competitive for non-preference applicants.
The duty station is Washington, DC, with telework but not remote work, so expect a commute from Manassas for in-office days.
